messages:
sarah_sales: Quick one — Nimbus is ready to start the POC. They want hosted API keys but with strict rotation and a clean deprovisioning plan. Can we outline the recommended flow (create/rotate/revoke) and any console/CLI steps we should give them?

anika_se: TL;DR: use short-lived hosted keys for POC, enable IP allowlist, restrict scopes to generation only, and schedule auto-rotation + final revocation when POC ends. I can paste steps. :white_check_mark:

kevin_sre: Agree. Add: create a service-account key instead of a user key, attach minimal policy (chat/generate only), and log all requests to our audit log. For POCs we usually do 7d TTL keys or 30d if partner requests.

anika_se: Steps we send to customer (console + CLI):
Console: Settings > API Keys > Create key > Name = "nimbus-poc-temp" > TTL = 7 days (or 30d on request) > IP allowlist: add their CIDR > Scopes: generation only > Create and copy once.
CLI (example):
```
redwood keys create --team=nimbus --name="nimbus-poc-temp" --ttl=7d --scopes=generate --ip-allowlist=203.0.113.0/24
# returns: key_id: rk_XXXX, secret: sk_live_YYYY (show once)
```

sarah_sales: Nice. What about rotation mid-POC? Customer asks to rotate every 2 weeks and they want zero-downtime.

anika_se: Zero-downtime: create new key, update client to send both keys during rollout (prefer new then remove old), or use short TTL with automatic issuance from their side. We can also put a reverse proxy with prefix-based caching if they need no client change.

kevin_sre: Our recommended safe pattern: 1) create new key, 2) update their integration to try new key first, fallback to old key for 24h, 3) revoke old key after verifying. We can script this in their infra repo. Example revoke call: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/keys/rk_OLD/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

ops-support: Heads up — for audit/compliance we require each POC key to be tied to a named service account and recorded in the POC ticket. Please file a ticket with the POC start/end dates so we can auto-schedule revocation. Ticket template: customer, key_id, ttl, ip_allowlist, owner.

deploy-bot: Key created: rk_demo123 (masked). Created by anika_se for team=nimbus TTL=7d ip_allowlist=203.0.113.0/24

sarah_sales: Perfect. Any concerns around leakage or long-lived keys? Nimbus asked if we support automatic rotation via KMS/HSM or if they need to do it themselves.

kevin_sre: We don't rotate hosted secret material in customer KMS for hosted keys. Options: 1) customer uses short TTL keys we issue, 2) customer runs a small token broker in their infra that exchanges short-lived internal creds for hosted API key, 3) for Private deployments we can integrate with customer KMS.

anika_se: Addendum: Best practice doc snippet to share: do not commit sk_live_* to repos, store in secret manager, use environment variables, and rotate every 7–30 days depending on exposure. If they insist on automation, provide a sample GH Action to rotate: 
```yaml
# rotate-key.yml (example)
steps:
  - name: Request new key
    run: redwood keys create --team=nimbus --name="nimbus-rotated" --ttl=7d --scopes=generate
  - name: Update secret manager
    run: update-secret-manager --name=REDWOOD_KEY --value=$NEW_KEY
  - name: Deprecate old key
    run: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/keys/$OLD_KEY/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

sarah_sales: Good. What about deprovisioning checklist at POC end?

anika_se: Checklist: 1) Revoke all POC keys, 2) Remove IP allowlist entries, 3) Close POC ticket and record audit log snapshot, 4) Confirm customer removed keys from their env, 5) If they used Dedicated pools, revert any capacity reservations.

ops-support: We'll run a final audit export. Please include customer confirmation step. If they used reserved Dedicated, open an offboarding ticket for capacity reclaim.

kevin_sre: Also recommend setting an automated calendar reminder tied to the POC end date (we do this for enterprise). If they ask for SLA during POC, route to sales-engineering — POC keys do not carry SLAs like Dedicated.

anika_se: I can draft a one-pager for Nimbus with the commands, rotation playbook, and deprovision checklist. Want me to drop here and ping legal for any extra wording?

sarah_sales: Yes please. Drop the one-pager and I'll send to Nimbus. Also include an example ticket body we can paste into our support portal. :pray: 

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: POC audit export on 2026-07-05 for ticket #POC-4891

sarah_sales: Thanks everyone — this is actionable. I’ll follow up after I get their CIDR and desired TTL.
